decisions.reason: The combined shuttering/de-shuttering robot extends the firm's core automation offer in a growing industry, and the firm's slack and R&D base let it carry the product while results build up, so there is no shortfall to trigger search.
The automatic de-shuttering robot is a modular part of the firm's established integrated plant solutions, so it is likely to meet aspirations and keeping it costs little.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots in automated pallet circulation, and with turnover growing and slack available, management has no reason to drop it.
The automatic shuttering robot is central to the firm's future-ready automation strategy and builds on established capabilities, so results are likely satisfactory and it will be kept.
